description: End-to-end encrypted file sharing, synchronization, and phone-to-computer backups.
notes: The upstream Windows build has not been tested on Windows and is unsigned; SmartScreen may display a warning.
QurbSpace has a built-in updater. Use Scoop to manage updates for this installation.
Synced files and the device key/index are stored under %USERPROFILE%\qurb; application settings are stored under %APPDATA%\qurb, outside the Scoop directory.

The published Windows NSIS payload currently omits WebView2Loader.dll, which the upstream Windows packaging instructions say must sit beside qurb-desktop.exe; Windows startup may fail until the upstream release is fixed.

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'QurbSpace NSIS uninstaller was not found in the Scoop version directory.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "QurbSpace NSIS uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }
